title: Logical Metatheorems for Abstract Spaces axiomatized in Positive Bounded Logic II: Metric spaces and the model-theoretic uniformity principle
summary: We extend the proof-theoretic treatment of uniform bound extraction from normed structures axiomatized in positive bounded logic [Advances in Mathematics, 290:503-551, 2016] (as developed for the model theory of Banach spaces) to the more general setting of abstract metric structures, including discrete structures viewed as classical first-order models. In particular, we establish uniform bound extraction theorems for our generalized framework for $\forall\exists$-sentences whose matrix is the negation of (an embedding of) a formula in positive bounded logic, whose proofs use saturation.
